常用目录直接放到桌面，文件变化自动刷新。连接 Everything 搜索本机文件: Keep frequently used folders on your desktop, with contents that refresh as files change. Connect Everything to search your computer without opening more windows.

整理面板会移动或删除我的文件吗？: Does organizing a panel move or delete my files?
把图标拖入桌面面板只改变收纳方式，原文件留在原处，关闭面板也不会删除文件。文件菜: Adding items to a desktop panel only organizes references. Closing a panel does not delete the originals. File commands such as delete, rename, cut, and paste in folder panels do affect real files.
搜索和空格预览需要额外安装吗？: Do search and file previews need other tools?
需要。搜索依赖 Everything；空格预览可使用 PowerToys Pee: Yes. Search uses Everything; previews use PowerToys Peek or QuickLook. Install these tools separately and enable the integration in LucidDesk settings.
日常使用推荐 setup.exe 安装版。普通 ZIP 免安装，配置保存在本地应: Choose setup.exe for everyday use. The standard ZIP runs without installation and stores settings in your local app data folder. Portable keeps settings in the app’s data folder. All three have the same features.
需要账号吗？桌面数据存在哪里？: Do I need an account? Where is my data stored?
LucidDesk 无需注册账号，设置和布局主要保存在本机。应用默认通过 Git: No account is needed. Settings and layouts are stored locally. Update checks use GitHub and can be disabled. External agents and tools handle data according to their own settings. Read the privacy guide
